title: Kononenkogroup
description: Pure paper white and pure black ink with one mid grey for secondary lines, and nothing else: an architect's monochrome. A tight neo-grotesk (Arimo) for headings, labels and numbers over a crisp text serif (Newsreader, display optical size) for statements; square corners, no shadows, hairline rules.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is its exact inverse (black paper, white ink, the same grey)
the site's black sections use the dark tokens on a light page (their blocks carry the dark class)
muted is the pale grey of media placeholders; muted-foreground is the rgb(146) grey of secondary text
radius is 0; the gutter is 16px on phones and 1.6vw (23px at 1440) from 1024px
no accent colour: primary is the ink itself
